title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether Litigation Preservation May Be Taken Against Deposits in Bank Accounts of Military Units as Parties to Economic Dispute Cases and Whether Military Funds May Be Compulsorily Transferred to Repay Debts

articles.content_en: Article 3. In the course of hearing economic dispute cases, if the People's Court discovers that a military organ or its subordinate units use an account that is not permitted for settlement of business transactions to engage in settlement of business transactions and commercial lending or guarantees, thereby violating state policies or laws, the People's Court may, according to law, take preservation measures in litigation and enforcement measures against the funds used in such account. The superior leading organ of the military party shall assist the People's Court in jointly ascertaining the situation of its account, and shall freeze or deduct it according to law.
